recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the seed across current build-scope sources and avoids duplicate commits for already-decided related issues.
issue_request: FHIR-14960 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested clearer OperationDefinition/Operations guidance that servers SHALL support POST for all operations and SHALL support GET for non-state-affecting operations whose parameters can be represented in the URL, without adding a hybrid CapabilityStatement variance rule.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by svn revision 14052, mirrored as git commit 4522f03c9617ba7df0907489136e0e449432c8dc. That commit added the POST/GET bullets to the old OperationDefinition spreadsheet, which later migrated into source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml, but it did not update source/operations.html.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion shows the original POST-vs-GET confusion. Later final issues refined the same area: FHIR-18197 removed the idempotent-reference wording, FHIR-36265 disambiguated the GET affectsState condition, and FHIR-51046 updated the Operations page from primitive-only criteria to datatypes with corresponding search types. FHIR-36265 and FHIR-51046 were already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/operations.html so the Operation Request section explicitly says servers SHALL support POST invocation for all operations. Changed source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml so the affectsState comment uses the current URL/search-type GET criterion while preserving the affectsState=false requirement.
source_changes: source/operations.html: replaced weak 'generally invoked by POST' wording with an explicit SHALL-support-POST-for-all-operations statement.

source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml: updated OperationDefinition.affectsState comment from the older primitive-only GET criterion to URL/search-type wording aligned with current Operations guidance.

related_jiras.note: Removed the misleading HTTP idempotent reference from affectsState without changing the POST/GET support model.
Clarified the OperationDefinition GET sentence so affectsState=false applies to the GET rule; already represented on the combined branch.
Updated the Operations page GET criterion from primitive-only/simple parameters to datatypes with corresponding search types; already represented on the combined branch.
Resolved - change required issue about non-conformance 'may' wording on Operations.html, not an Applied/Published decision for this seed.
